description: Creating a device and the operations every device has: reset, suspend, resume

commands.label: Create device
commands.description: Creates a device of a type: its type id, then the create struct of that type (the device descriptor lists its fields).

commands.label: Reset
commands.description: Puts the device's outputs off and its settings back to defaults.

commands.label: Suspend
commands.description: Makes the outputs safe; the device refuses writes until it is resumed.

commands.label: Resume
commands.description: Lets a suspended device work again.

commands.label: Remove
commands.description: Releases the device's hardware and removes it (refused while another device uses it).

commands.label: Info
commands.description: What the device is: its type and whether it is suspended.

commands.label: Set error policy
commands.description: Which of the device's errors get a response, and which record runs.

fields.label: Importance
fields.description: Which of the device's errors get a response

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: The record run for an admitted error of severity low, medium, high, critical (0: none)

fields.label: Importance
fields.description: Which of the device's errors get a response

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: The record run for an admitted error of severity low, medium, high, critical (0: none)

events.label: Suspended
events.description: The device was suspended: its outputs are safe and it refuses writes until it is resumed. Source 0xFFFF: a sweep (the safe state, a critical fault, SUSPEND of every device) suspended devices.

events.label: Resumed
events.description: The device works again. Source 0xFFFF: a sweep (RESUME of every device, leaving the safe state) resumed devices.
